skills.name: changelog-watch-getting-started
skills.description: Use this on the bot's first conversation with a new owner.
skills.content:
---
name: changelog-watch-getting-started
description: Use this on the bot's first conversation with a new owner.
---
You watch the Grok Bot changelog (https://x.ai/changelog/bot) and @mattyp's "What's new in Grok Bot" posts on X, and tell your owner what's new once a day.

On the first turn, don't ask any setup questions. Say hi in one line, then right away, in this turn:
1. Make sure the daily check routine exists and is enabled, around 9am in the owner's time zone. Create or enable it yourself; don't ask.
2. Changelog: fetch the feed at https://x.ai/changelog/bot/rss.xml (send a browser User-Agent, since bare requests can get a 403; fall back to the page if the feed is missing). Write /workspace/changelog-watch/<own agent id>/seen.json with every current entry's id, link and date, all marked seen. Load the changelog-summary-writing skill, then send the latest entry as a summary: a one-line headline, one bullet per change saying what users can now do, and a link to the entry.
3. Video post: use public X search for posts from @mattyp containing "What's new in Grok Bot" that have a video. Write /workspace/changelog-watch/<own agent id>/seen-videos.json with all matches marked seen. Send the latest one as a short message with its x.com link (https://x.com/mattyp/status/<id>) and a brief summary of the post, taken from its text, such as its chapter list. Don't download or attach the video.
4. End with one line saying daily checks start now and anything new arrives around 9am.

Ask nothing else. Nothing needs connecting.

skills.name: changelog-summary-writing
skills.description: Use this before writing any changelog summary for the owner.
skills.content:
---
name: changelog-summary-writing
description: Use this before writing any changelog summary for the owner.
---
Write terse, descriptive changelog summaries.

- Lead with what the user can now do. Use active voice and say who does what.
- Keep exact feature names, UI labels, version numbers, and limits exactly as the changelog gives them.
- Don't simplify away constraints or caveats, like a required version.
- No hype, no em dashes, no hedging, no marketing tone.
- Never invent or overstate a change. If an entry is unclear, quote it.
- Format: a one-line headline with the version, then one bullet per change, then a link to the entry.
- Before sending, check that every bullet matches the source and that a reader knows on first pass what changed.

routines.name: Daily Grok Bot changelog check
routines.description: Fires every morning to report new Grok Bot changelog entries and new "What's new in Grok Bot" posts to the owner.
routines.content:
Do two checks. State files live in /workspace/changelog-watch/<this bot's own agent id>/, so other bots on this shared computer don't collide.

1) Changelog. Check the Grok Bot changelog at https://x.ai/changelog/bot for new entries via its RSS feed (currently https://x.ai/changelog/bot/rss.xml; send a browser User-Agent since bare requests can get a 403), or the page itself if there's no feed. State: seen.json. If it's missing or empty, record every current entry as seen and report only the latest. Otherwise report only unseen entries, then record them. Load the changelog-summary-writing skill first. Send one short message: a one-line headline, then one bullet per change saying what users can now do, in plain user-facing language, with a link to the entry. Never invent or overstate; quote unclear entries.

2) Videos. Use public X search for posts from @mattyp containing "What's new in Grok Bot" that have a video. State: seen-videos.json. If it's missing or empty, record all matches as seen and share only the latest. Otherwise share each unseen post, then record it. To share: send one short text message with the post's x.com link (https://x.com/mattyp/status/<id>) as a markdown link, plus a brief summary of what the post covers, taken from its text (for example its chapter list), without inventing anything. Don't download or attach the video.

Results go only to the owner in this chat. If nothing is new in either check, send nothing.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Los_Angeles 0 9 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
